ops.title: Fold an explicit wire-format version into the mesh SchemaFingerprint
ops.description: SchemaFingerprint hashes only the migrations (internal/store/store.go:327-332). bb62a4b changed Refs.PRs from []int to []PR, which encodes repo-qualified refs as owner/repo#N strings, without changing it. An older peer still matched and failed at body decode: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field Refs.rows.refs.prs of type int (synckit log 2026-10-16 05:11:44). Add store.WireFormat folded into the fingerprint and a CI golden test over a maximal change body that fails unless the version is bumped. Keep repo-qualified PRs, no fallback decoder, no remote deployment or remote version claims. Rollout needs cci mesh enable on each Mac, so it is blocked on the debounce-preserve task. Evidence: /tmp/host-relief-20261015-1939/synckit-sync-failure-0530.json, /tmp/host-relief-20261015-1939/cci-37-candidate-design.json.

ops.text: golden encoding test in internal/mesh covers every replicated field, bare-int and repo-qualified PRs
CHANGELOG states the fleet re-enable and the Backoff-until-upgraded behavior
no fallback decoder; repo-qualified PR refs unchanged
